analysis_type: post-hoc descriptive; not a new training run or preregistered primary outcome

definitions.hard_load: fraction of fixed-panel patch argmax assignments, excluding CLS
definitions.window: first positive evaluation step through endpoint; excludes random-initialization step zero
definitions.time_average: trapezoidal interpolation across recorded steps; not a continuous observation
definitions.majority: one expert gets strictly more than half of fixed-panel patch assignments
definitions.inactive: zero patch assignments on a panel or training batch, not proof of no gradients
definitions.training: actual noisy masked augmented accepted-image assignments; pooled and per-batch
definitions.intervals: descriptive paired 95% t intervals; exploratory and not multiplicity-adjusted
